selectedTask.title: Serialize existing case and area-watch consequences in the headless debrief
selectedTask.acceptanceScope: Accept this bounded export selection; reject the claim that a second-takedown fix is presently justified. Implementation remains a separate handoff.
selectedTask.contract: Add nextMission.cases entries {who,kind,place,missions} and nextMission.areaWatch entries {place,guards,cameras,missions} from existing tuples in their existing order. Omit each empty collection to preserve empty-case output. Preserve current who role/id convention, coordinate-string place values, -1 missing-case lifetime, aggregate fields and prose. No new block mapping, campaign progression or consequence calculation.
risks: Existing who values mix role aliases and person IDs; export faithfully and document this, do not imply stable campaign identity.
place is a scene coordinate string, not a block ID; export cannot claim generated block guard/camera placement.
Prose already exposes the consequences, so value is structured integration fidelity, not a wholly missing debrief feature.
Additive keys may affect strict downstream JSON consumers; inspect consumers and preserve existing fields and empty output.
acceptanceTests: N47 missing-person fixture: parse serialized debrief; verify one guard missing case, existing scene place, missions=-1, watch +1 guard/+1 camera for 3 missions; check tuples are preserved and retain aggregate/prose compatibility.
Use an existing order-driven found-killing fixture; assert found-killing lifetime from the rulebook and matching scene/watch data, with expected values independent of writer output.
No-case successful debrief: no new empty fields under the proposed contract; existing FailCauseTests remain passing.
Repeated Debrief.Of/Write yields deterministic JSON and leaves full simulation state hashes/checkpoints unchanged. Selected scenario replays stay identical.
Run focused C# tests for changed serializer and chosen scenarios; record any unrelated pre-existing suite failure separately.
selectedTask.explicitLimitation: This completes a serialization boundary only. It does not implement campaign persistence, case aging/closure, next-mission security input, block identification or guard/camera placement; it is not complete GDD coverage or a completed revised goals-agent live demonstration.

handoff.doneCheck: Focused export assertions, compatibility, query purity and deterministic replay pass; no new campaign behavior.
handoff.nextOwner: Aster assigns Keel implementation; Suture or Redline independently checks acceptance.
